title: Gonna cancel the rest of my shows and just see London Hadestown 20 mo...
transcript: Welcome to the great theatre Adventure Day 16, another beautiful day of seeing two shows in London. Started tackling a little bit of the French schedule before visiting the Today Ticks booth and grabbing one of these free pin badges. Grabbed a quick bite to eat and did some walking around the city. He even spotted some of these mysterious red envelopes from Today Tics and headed to the first show of the day at Hadestown. Yes, this is my second Hades town of the trip, but my first time seeing it in the West End with the London cast. One of the reasons why I keep going back to the show is every time I see it with a new cast, it's basically like a new show, and this London cast was no exception. In an exciting surprise event, we got to see Ali Daniels debut as Hermes. She was in incredible. And I got to see Donald and Grace as Orpheus and Eurydice before they leave to go work on their next projects. after grabbing a quick bite to eat and meeting up with some friends and filming absolutely none of that, it was time to be eat the rain and head over to the Duke of York for Jamie Lloyd's Romeo and Juliet. I love Jamie Lloyd as a director. I have so many thoughts on this production. There is definitely going to be a full review coming because this production was definitely something, as was the Incredibly entertaining crowd at the Stage Door. Overall a fantastic day of seeing theater in this unintentional Sunset Boulevard themed two show day. See you tomorrow!
